issues.title: Unpinned Docker Image (Missing Tag or :latest)
issues.fix: Pin image to an explicit version tag or SHA256 digest (e.g., node:20.11-alpine).

issues.title: Remote Script Piped Directly to Shell (curl | bash)
issues.fix: Download script first, verify its SHA256 checksum or signature, then execute it.

issues.title: Overly Broad Workflow Write Permissions
issues.fix: Use least-privilege permissions (e.g., permissions: { contents: read }).

issues.title: Unpinned npm Install in CI Without Lockfile Enforcement
issues.fix: Use npm ci to enforce lockfile versions or pass --save-exact when adding packages.
